environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volume mounts are defined in the pod manifest. The container image uses a distroless base with no shell. Additionally, a Cilium L3/L4 NetworkPolicy is applied to the pod's namespace that restricts egress to only port 443 on a predefined set of CIDR ranges (10.0.0.0/8 denied, 169.254.0.0/16 denied, 100.64.0.0/10 denied via explicit deny-all with allowlist). The pod runs with a non-root UID (65534) and has no CAP_NET_RAW capability.
